name: skills-manager
description: Autonomous Skills Router — discover, route, assemble 4-phase pipeline & report skills
expansion:
Invoke the "skills-manager" meta-skill for this task: $ARGUMENTS

Follow the Skills Manager deterministic routing workflow:
1. Pre-Flight Routing: Run `skills-router route "$ARGUMENTS"` (or use the Two-Stage Deterministic Routing Engine).
2. Follow the Decision Triad:
   - If `route`: Adopt the returned skill(s) or minimal disjoint multi-skill plan. Declare the 4-phase pipeline (Guardrails → Pre-Execution → Execution → Verification) and read only the matched SKILL.md file(s) (progressive disclosure).
   - If `ambiguous`: Present the competing choices to the user and ask for clarification before editing code.
   - If `no_route`: Proceed with standard generalist reasoning.
3. User-Facing Skill Reporting Rule: In your response, explicitly report in a few words what skills were used and why:
   > 🛠️ **Skills Applied:**
   > - `<skill-name>`: <why it was used in 5-10 words>

name: route
description: Fast route query to skills-router for optimal skill or multi-skill plan
expansion:
Route this task using the deterministic skills router: $ARGUMENTS

1. Run `skills-router route "$ARGUMENTS"` to match the task against the project and global skill catalog.
2. If routed, declare the 4-phase pipeline and execute using the matched skill instructions.
3. In your response, report what skills are used and why in a few words:
   > 🛠️ **Skills Applied:**
   > - `<skill-name>`: <why in a few words>
